requested_fields: nsys.prefill_window_kernel_timeline: independent native kernel entries and ordering within the t0-to-first-token-ready window, to corroborate the candidate-declared bitexact-composite and bitexact-composite-gated routes (728 invocations) with actual executed kernels rather than candidate-reported telemetry

nsys.prefill_window_gaps_and_sync: GPU idle gaps, serialization and synchronize events inside the ttft window, including any silent parent-fallback execution analogous to the trial bundle's parent-fallback:setup-failure:flash-dispatch-refused route
execution_timeline.cpu_submit_to_cuda_association: submit-versus-execute intervals for prefill operators to split ttft_ms into host-dispatch and GPU-execution components
execution_timeline.first_token_sync_bounds: synchronization points and clock-alignment bounds around the explicit first-token-ready torch.cuda.synchronize that closes the ttft window

candidate_diagnostics.route_and_exception_evidence: actual route decisions and any exception/setup-failure evidence for the candidate's call sites on this exact revision, to confirm or refute the declared composite/gated routing

unavailable_fields.nccl_algorithm_protocol_channel_decision: Single-device task on one leased RTX 4090; request.json has distributed_backend null and observations.json marks communication not_applicable with reason 'single-device task'; no NCCL communicators exist, so nccl_tuning has no referent and kernel entry names could not identify protocol anyway.
unavailable_fields.per_collective_bytes_and_clean_collectiv: No collectives occur in the measured invocation; collective_calibration's synthetic full-world allreduce has no counterpart to join to operator groups on this workload.
unavailable_fields.per_operation_pcie_nvlink_traffic: The measured unit starts after the prompt tensor is already GPU-resident; device_telemetry provides only device-wide NVML rates with native windows that cannot be attributed per operation, and PCIe/NVLink traffic must not be invented from logical payload or memcpy sizes.
unavailable_fields.binding_layer_overhead_ab: Both bundles bound with effective 'direct' binding, reason 'no functional replacements' (evaluation setup); no functional binding layer exists to isolate with binding_cost, which in any case reports only whole-invocation cost.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion_bo: execution_timeline reports clock-alignment bounds for CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown and are retained as unknown rather than inferred.

rationale: The only listed revision is ab9f308cda6860bd102fb93077b9d1414f1d7fadcfbfc7b997cd53131bf09f2d (bundle repair-treatment-param-70a89eea): quality pass, ttft_ms 23.57 vs paired parent 24.83, decode 671 ms at 46.2 tok/s, zero framework fallbacks. Two uncertainties remain in the observed evidence. (1) Route truth: all 728 candidate invocations are labeled bitexact-composite / bitexact-composite-gated, but evaluation.interpretation states these are candidate-reported telemetry, not independent native proof, and the earlier trial bundle on this same code path silently fell back (parent-fallback:setup-failure:flash-dispatch-refused, 2 of 64 invocations), so route drift is demonstrably possible and the source of the ~1.26 ms TTFT improvement is unverified. (2) TTFT attribution: the remaining ~23.6 ms first-token window is not decomposed into GPU kernel execution versus host submission/synchronization stalls; the already-completed torch run (coverage.json: 66441/66441 kernels associated, 0 unassociated, 0 ambiguous) resolves kernel-to-operation attribution but neither corroborates declared routes nor times submit versus execute. Therefore: nsys (binary present in request tools) for an independent native kernel timeline of the prefill/first-token-ready window to corroborate the composite routes and expose idle gaps and any fallback execution; execution_timeline for CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization and per-device intervals to split ttft_ms between host dispatch and GPU execution; candidate_diagnostics for actual route and exception evidence on this exact candidate. Exclusions: torch already ran with full association; nccl_tuning, collective_calibration and per-collective fields have no referent on this single-GPU, no-communication workload; device_telemetry gives only device-wide readings that cannot attribute a GPU-resident-prompt TTFT window; binding_cost is inapplicable because effective binding is 'direct' with 'no functional replacements'; python_runtime is not selected because its perturbing cProfile drill-down is justified only if execution_timeline shows host-bound submission.
